title: Personal Time Capsule — data/provenance/events.yaml
description: Structural schema for a capsule's append-only event/provenance log. See ../METADATA.md for the field-by-field explanation and rationale. Covers ROADMAP.md item 10 (metadata model) only.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for this event (e.g. "evt-2026-08-30-import-email"), useful if a future object-level metadata record ever needs to reference back to the event that produced it.

date.description: ISO 8601 date the event occurred. Must be a quoted string, per the same YAML gotcha documented in FORMAT.md.

type.description: The first 11 values match capsule.yaml's status.lifecycle_stage enum (LIFECYCLE.md's main stages). The last 3 are recurring sub-events named in LIFECYCLE.md stage 8 that aren't stage transitions themselves.

agent.description: Free text identifying who or what performed this event — a person and their ACTORS.md role (e.g. "Jane Smith (creator)"), or a piece of software and version (e.g. "ptc CLI v0.1"). Not a structured registry — see METADATA.md's open questions.

collection.description: Optional. When an event pertains to one named collection rather than the whole capsule, this should match a collections[].name entry in capsule.yaml.

source.description: Optional. Free-text provenance description — primarily for import events, e.g. "Gmail Takeout export, jane@example.org".

outcome.description: Optional. Free-text result of the event, most relevant for fixity_check (e.g. "pass", "3 files failed checksum").

note.description: Optional. Any other free-text context worth recording.
